question:
**Choose the correct active voice transformation of the sentence:**

The renowned author’s newest novel will have been released by the end of the year.

options.text: The renowned author will have been releasing his newest novel by the end of the year.
The renowned author will release his newest novel by the end of the year.
The renowned author will have released his newest novel by the end of the year.
The renowned author has released his newest novel by the end of the year.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. The renowned author will have released his newest novel by the end of the year .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the future perfect tense in the active voice.
 
• In future perfect tense sentences, the passive voice structure is: **S**ubject **+ will have + past participle + **Object **.**
 
• The correct transformation of the given sentence to active voice is: The renowned author will have released his newest novel by the end of the year.

Correct sentence: ***The renowned author will have released his newest novel by the end of the year.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Active Voice:** The renowned author will have released his newest novel by the end of the year.

 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + will have + past participle + object.
 
 
 
• **Passive Voice:** The renowned author’s newest novel will have been released by the end of the year.
 
 
• **Structure:** Object + will have been + past participle + by + subject.
